question: Do first-jet Gram compatibility and a fixed connectivity source select the canonical affine sigma-intertwiner X=T uniquely at widths 2,3,4?

spaces.module: V_w is the rational vector space on circular noncrossing connectivity states in repository order
spaces.radical: R_w={x: one^T x=0}, with columns B_a=e_a-e_last
spaces.first_jet_gram: G1(pi,sigma)=number of blocks of the join pi vee sigma; H=B^T G1 B
spaces.distinguished_source: s0 is the all-singleton connectivity state (0,1,...,w-1)

affine_sigma_intertwiner: X e_i = e_(i+1 mod w) X for every periodic join generator
frozen_equations.endpoint_normalization: one^T X=one^T; equivalently X preserves the Q=1 endpoint quotient and maps R_w to itself
frozen_equations.gram_self_adjoint: for the induced radical map A defined by X B=B A, require H A=A^T H

outputs.dimension: For homogeneous stages report vector-space nullity; for normalized stages report affine-solution tangent dimension or inconsistency.
outputs.basis: Give a deterministic rational particular solution and primitive-integer tangent basis in row-major matrix coordinates.
outputs.canonical_test: At each stage report exact residual ranks for X=T.
outputs.remaining_moduli: If the final tangent dimension is positive, parameterize X=X0+sum_a theta_a Y_a. If zero, state uniqueness. If inconsistent, state that no normalized Gram-compatible confluence exists in this quotient.

decision_rule.canonical_unique: The final affine solution exists, has tangent dimension zero, and its particular solution equals T.
decision_rule.canonical_not_unique: The final affine solution exists with positive tangent dimension and contains T.
decision_rule.canonical_excluded: The final affine solution exists but T violates at least one frozen equation.
decision_rule.empty_intersection: The final affine equation system is inconsistent.

claim_boundary: This is exact rational algebra only in the width-2,3,4 noncrossing join representation.
The first-jet Gram is restricted from the full connectivity pairing; no generic-Q detach or loop-weight generator is added.
Source normalization fixes the declared all-singleton source and must not be reinterpreted as a measured thermal insertion.
Uniqueness here would not overcome PR385 finite-noise nonseparation without an independently justified physical spectral or symmetry condition.
